coverage: The 48-byte little-endian RESOURCE_FLUSH fixture round-trips every field and rejects a truncated request.
The control-queue path records an exact damage rectangle, dimensions, fence response, and CRC-32 from a TestSink; the default NullSink accepts the same headless path.

Unbound flushes are forwarded, SET_SCANOUT(resource_id = 0) leaves an old live resource flushable without a scanout binding, and a flush after RESOURCE_UNREF returns INVALID_RESOURCE_ID without a sink event.
Unknown resources, short requests, outside-edge rectangles, and overflowing coordinates return INVALID_RESOURCE_ID or INVALID_PARAMETER without a sink event.

The five-pattern integration test drives guest writes through CREATE_2D, multi-entry ATTACH_BACKING, SET_SCANOUT, TRANSFER_TO_HOST_2D, and RESOURCE_FLUSH; full-frame, partial, odd-x, multi-entry, and edge-touching cases match hard-coded CRC fixtures from an independent branch-based reference.
The golden test mutates a checked fixture and asserts the independent comparison fails, then verifies guest backing mutation after transfer cannot change the host shadow or recorded CRC.
